ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 65-70% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels concentrated at the trailing edges and center, and 30-35% mid-to-high intensity (grey/white) mottled pixels on the interior lobe surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white and light-grey mottled blobs are centrally located on both the left and right lobes. Solid low-intensity black pixels define the trailing edges, the central notch, and the primary structural frame of the fluke.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide, symmetrical V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 110 degrees, exhibiting a moderate depth relative to the horizontal fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-amplitude, irregular serrations characterized by deep jagged peaks and valleys; specific deep-notched pixel voids are visible across the continuous trailing boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex upward curvature along the posterior edge, terminating in tapered, slightly hooked distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups are concentrated on the distal tips and along the leading anterior margins, suggesting focal barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, dark, near-vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) are visible intersecting the lighter pigmentation zones on the mid-section of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular tissue loss and jagged lacerations along the trailing edge, notably a deep, dark triangular void on the inner left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy calcified-texture encrustations are visible at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
